core.module.name: Core
core.module.description: The platform itself: settings, modules, background work and the audit log. Always on.
core.settings.site.name.label: The theatre's name
core.settings.site.name.help: Shown in the site's header, on emails and in page titles. Set during setup.
core.settings.locale.time-zone.label: Time zone
core.settings.locale.time-zone.help: Where the theatre is. Dates, times and scheduled work follow this zone, including the clock changes. Set during setup; until then scheduled work runs on UTC.
core.settings.locale.currency.label: Currency
core.settings.locale.currency.help: The three-letter code of the currency prices are in, such as GBP.
core.settings.locale.language.label: Language
core.settings.locale.language.help: The language the site is written in, as a code such as en-GB.
core.settings.locale.day-start.label: When the theatre's day starts
core.settings.locale.day-start.help: Anything before this time counts as the previous day, so a late show's sales and takings stay with the evening they belong to.
core.settings.units.statement-limit.labe: Most database statements in one change
core.settings.units.statement-limit.help: A change that would need more is refused before anything is written. Raise it only if a screen says it was refused for this reason.
core.settings.units.set-rows-limit.label: Most rows written together in one change
core.settings.units.set-rows-limit.help: When one change writes many similar rows at once, such as a message to everyone booked for a performance, they are written together up to this number. A change that would write more in one go is refused before anything is written.
core.settings.jobs.attempts.label: Attempts before background work gives up
core.settings.jobs.attempts.help: How many times a background job is tried before it is shown on the health screen as failed.
core.settings.jobs.backoff.label: First wait before trying again
core.settings.jobs.backoff.help: How long a failed background job waits before its second attempt. Each later wait is twice as long.
core.settings.jobs.timeout.label: Longest a background job may run
core.settings.jobs.timeout.help: A job still running after this long is treated as stopped and tried again.
core.settings.jobs.keep-for.label: Keep finished background work for
core.settings.jobs.keep-for.help: How long the record of finished jobs and scheduled runs is kept.
core.settings.external.timeout.label: Wait for an outside service
core.settings.external.timeout.help: How long to wait for a payment provider or another outside service before treating the answer as unknown.
core.settings.external.reconcile-after.h: When an outside service did not answer, how long to wait before asking it what happened.
core.settings.access.fresh-within.label: Confirm it is you every
core.settings.access.fresh-within.help: For sensitive actions, how recently a person must have confirmed their sign-in.
core.settings.idempotency.keep-for.label: Remember repeated requests for
core.settings.idempotency.keep-for.help: How long a request that may be repeated, such as a payment, is remembered so it is not carried out twice.
core.settings.rate-limits.default.label: Requests a minute: reading
core.settings.rate-limits.default.help: How many ordinary requests one person or address may make in a minute.
core.settings.rate-limits.write.label: Requests a minute: changes
core.settings.rate-limits.write.help: How many changes one person or address may make in a minute.
core.settings.rate-limits.sign-in.label: Requests a minute: signing in
core.settings.rate-limits.sign-in.help: How many sign-in attempts one person or address may make in a minute.
core.settings.rate-limits.public-form.he: How many public form submissions one address may make in a minute.
core.settings.rate-limits.export.label: Requests a minute: exports
core.settings.rate-limits.export.help: How many exports one person may start in a minute.
core.settings.retention.audit.label: Keep the audit log for
core.settings.retention.audit.help: How long the record of who did what is kept. Names in older entries are removed after this.
Keep the history of setting changes for
How long the history of who changed each setting, and why, is kept.
core.settings.rules.time-zone-known: That is not a time zone we recognise. Use a name such as Europe/London.
core.settings.rules.currency-code: Use a three-letter currency code in capitals, such as GBP.
core.settings.rules.language-known: That is not a language code we recognise. Use one such as en-GB.
core.abilities.settings.manage.label: Change the platform's settings
core.abilities.modules.manage.label: Switch modules on and off
core.abilities.job.manage.label: Cancel background work that has not started
core.settings.sign-in.email-link.label: Sign in by emailed link and code
core.settings.sign-in.email-link.help: Whether people can be sent a link and a code to sign in. Passkeys are always available.
core.settings.sign-in.link-lifetime.help: How long a sign-in link and its code work after they are sent.
core.settings.sign-in.code-attempts.help: How many wrong codes may be typed before the person has to ask for a new email.
core.settings.sign-in.open-sign-up.label: Anyone can create an account
core.settings.sign-in.open-sign-up.help: When this is off, only people who already have an account can sign in. Buying tickets as a guest still works.
core.settings.sign-in.google.label: Sign in with Google
core.settings.sign-in.google.help: Offer a “Sign in with Google” button. Needs the Google client id below and the Google secret set on the Worker.
core.settings.sign-in.google-client-id.h: The client id from your Google Cloud project's OAuth credentials. It ends in .apps.googleusercontent.com.
core.settings.sign-in.google-domains.hel: Only Google accounts from these organisation domains may sign in. Leave empty to accept any Google account.
core.settings.sign-in.managed-domains.he: Email domains whose addresses sign in only through Google and are never sent a sign-in link.
core.settings.sign-in.provider-is-strong: Treat Google sign-in from these domains as strong
Turn on only if your Google organisation makes everyone use two-step sign-in. Then a Google sign-in counts like a passkey.
core.settings.sessions.lifetime.label: Stay signed in for at most
core.settings.sessions.lifetime.help: The longest a browser stays signed in before the person must sign in again.
core.settings.sessions.idle-limit.label: Sign out after being unused for
core.settings.sessions.idle-limit.help: A browser that has not been used for this long is signed out.
core.settings.recovery.code-count.label: Recovery codes in a set
core.settings.recovery.code-count.help: How many single-use recovery codes a person is given with their first passkey.
core.settings.grants.default-expiry.help: What a new role's end date starts as. Year end suits a committee that changes every year.
core.settings.grants.default-expiry.opti: At the end of the committee year
core.settings.grants.allow-no-expiry.lab: Roles may be given with no end date
core.settings.grants.allow-no-expiry.hel: When this is off, every role given must have an end date, except Owner.
core.settings.members-area.enabled.label: Members' area
core.settings.members-area.enabled.help: Whether the members' area exists at all. When it is off nobody sees a link to it.
core.settings.members-area.name.label: What you call the members' area
core.settings.members-area.name.help: Shown in the header and on screens, such as “Company area” or “Volunteers”.
core.settings.merge.undo-window.label: A merge can be undone for
core.settings.merge.undo-window.help: How long after two accounts are merged the merge can still be undone.
core.settings.rules.idle-within-lifetime: The unused time limit cannot be longer than the longest time a browser stays signed in.
core.settings.rules.managed-domains-need: Addresses can be made to use Google only while Google sign-in is on.
core.settings.rules.strong-provider-need: Google sign-in can count as strong only for addresses that must use Google. Add a domain first.
core.settings.rules.google-needs-client-: Google sign-in needs the Google client id. Add it first.
Google sign-in needs the CORE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET Worker secret. Set it first.
core.settings.rules.domains-are-domains: Each entry must be a domain, such as newtheatre.org.uk, with no @ and no spaces.
core.abilities.account.search.label: Find people by name or address
core.abilities.account.read.label: See a person's details and how they sign in
core.abilities.account.disable.label: Disable and enable accounts
core.abilities.account.merge.label: Merge two accounts
core.abilities.session.end.label: Sign a person out of their browsers
core.abilities.role.read.label: See roles and what they allow
core.abilities.role.manage.label: Create and edit roles
core.abilities.grant.read.label: See who holds which role
core.abilities.grant.manage.label: Give and end roles
